text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Hanshin JF just around the corner, as I was eating in the cafeteria on this day, a colleague spoke to me.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I heard about it. About your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"About you and your Trainer.
I heard you were incredibly selfish and caused quite a lot of trouble for the staff."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Pull yourself together.
Guiding your trainee Uma Musume
is a Trainer's job!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Still, even kids
aren't completely blind to the way forward.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Even without adults to guide me,
I have my own compass.
I'm not some clueless baby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...? What is it?
You're spacing out.
choice_data_list: ...I was just lost in thought for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And on the day of the Hanshin JF,
there was another Umamusume waiting at the meetup spot alongside Sweep Tosho."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sweep, hold on.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...The other day, I saw you half-asleep,
saying you 'didn't want to' race.
And so..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If your current situation
is hindering your own growth,
you should walk away from it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you want to sit out the race, sit it out.
If you hate the interviews, just turn them down.
If you need help, I'll lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Or is your source of unease your Trainer?
If you wish to change assignments—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I hate that kind of thing the most!
I hate it, hate it, hate it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha! You got rejected, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (She is Tokai Teio. A charismatic Umamusume who captivates people's hearts with feats like her miraculous comeback from injury.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Were you watching, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's just too motherly, you know?
Isn't that why Sweep turned her down too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Who are you calling a mom?!
I'm just—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If you're that worried, why not sneak in to watch the race?
I'm going to watch too, since there's someone I have high hopes for~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...From an outsider's perspective, our current relationship
probably looks concerning not just to other Trainers,
but to the Umamusume as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is pouting.
I still don't know the best way to soothe her
when she suddenly gets into a foul mood like today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our relationship isn't like a parent and child where one coddles the other.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Sweep, I know you can do it

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
